title: Easy Shulker Boxes / Mortar Compatibility
description: Adds compatibility between Easy Shulker Boxes and Mortar's colored shulker boxes and bundles.
body:
Adds compatibility between [Easy Shulker Boxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes) and [Mortar (and Pastels)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mortar). 

Very simple datapack that allows Easy Shulker Boxes features to work with Mortar's 8 additional shulker box colors (maroon, scarlet, amber, pear, pine, slate, lavender, salmon) and their bundles.

Only tested on Minecraft Fabric 1.21.5, though it should work on any version.
